nom: Philosophy Hope In A Jar Biome-Balance Glow Serum

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, psoriasis or dry, flaky patches, consistently report the serum leaves their skin more hydrated, soft and smooth, with several noting reduced redness or flaking within weeks.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some prone to irritation from other 'glow' products, report the serum calms dullness and adds hydration without triggering breakouts or irritation.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-acne-prone skin say the lightweight, water-like texture absorbs quickly and adds glow or hydration without clogging pores or leaving shine, though one dry-skin reviewer suggests oily skin might notice a bit of shine.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin, oily on waking, reports her face looks brighter in the morning without greasiness after using the serum.
segments.mature: Reviewers in or approaching their 40s and those describing their skin as aging report firmer, plumper, smoother skin, fading fine lines, smaller pores and less visible neck crepe with continued use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, including several around or past 40, report firmer, plumper, smoother-looking skin and fading fine lines with regular use, some noting visibly smaller pores; a couple of reviewers instead report no visible effect even with consistent use, and one notes the serum can't smooth pre-existing textured scarring.
concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority of reviewers, across skin types, report a lightweight formula that leaves skin noticeably more hydrated, soft, plump and glowing without stickiness or heaviness; a small minority report no visible improvement even with consistent use, and one reviewer wishes it absorbed a little more easily.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, psoriasis or general redness and dry, scaly patches report their skin looking calmer and smoother after weeks of consistent use, including one who specifically notes less redness in photos taken before and after.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers, including some with sensitive or reactive skin, credit the serum with supporting or helping repair their skin barrier, describing calmer, bouncier-feeling skin with continued use.
concerns.spots: The serum includes a vitamin C derivative marketed to brighten and fade dark spots; the one reviewer who mentions dark spots was drawn to this claim for her hyperpigmentation but doesn't confirm a result in her review, while another with developing dark spots reports brighter, glowing skin from using it alongside a separate vitamin C serum.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or oily-acne skin say the serum doesn't clog pores or cause new breakouts, including one who layers it over an acne treatment gel without issue; one reviewer instead reports it broke her out and stopped using it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin generally say the formula absorbs quickly and adds glow without shine or greasiness; one reviewer with dry skin cautions that those with oily skin might find it leaves a little shine.

aspects.libelle: Can pill up when layered under makeup
A few find the scent too strong
A little product goes a long way

extraits.titre: It's a no for me dawg
extraits.texte: I really wanted to like this serum because it seems super simple. My skin just doesn't jive with it. It broke me out, so while I didn't use it long it's a no.

I bought this hoping it would smooth out my rough red skin and it has exceeded everything i was hoping it would. I have rosacea and psoriasis so my skin is dry scaly and red. I used this for about 4 weeks religiously day ans night and night. Now my face feels as smooth as a babys butt.

I've been a big fan of this brand for months, and I keep coming back because the products really work! This serum has such a smooth, lightweight texture, and my skin drinks it right up. As soon as I apply it, my skin looks fresher and feels super hydrated. I have really dry skin, and this even helps soften the fine lines on my forehead from dryness. Plus, my pores look way smaller thanks to all the hydration. Definitely a new favorite!

extraits.titre: Glow Up: The Perfect Serum for Busy Moms & Oily Sk
extraits.texte: As a busy mom and someone approaching 40 this August, keeping up with a solid skincare routine is a must for me! I need products that work without feeling like an extra chore, and Philosophy's Hope in a dropper Biome-Balance Glow Serum has been a game-changer. The packaging is super sleek and I love the white bottle! First off, let's talk about the scent—it's subtle but so nice! To me, it has a warm vanilla-amber vibe that feels cozy and luxurious but isn't overpowering. The texture is light, super moisturizing, and absorbs quickly, which is perfect for my oily skin. I can't stand heavy or greasy products, and this strikes the right balance of hydration without the shine. I also love that this serum is packed with hyaluronic acid (all the rage right now for good reason!), prebiotics, and AAG2™ to help keep my skin fresh and glowing. I've trusted Philosophy for years, and they never disappoint. If you're looking for a great daily serum that feels amazing and delivers results, this is it! Definitely repurchasing!

extraits.titre: Leaves you with beautiful and glowing skin!
extraits.texte: This serum has helped my skin so much. As someone who struggles with extremely dry skin it definitely helps bring some moisture to the skin! If you do have oily skin, it is still a great option but may leave you a little shiny! Doesn't have a strong scent either! Packaging is also nice and aesthetically pleasing to the eye!

extraits.titre: Great for skin support and glow!
extraits.texte: This works beautifully with my more on the dry side, dull, sensitive skin! Some glow serums I have tried irritated my skin but this one didn't at all. It's incredibly lightweight and absorbs quickly without being sticky or tacky. It does have a very faint scent at first but it dissappears fast. My skin has a beautiful glow to it since I been using this and makes me look forward to when I get to apply it again everyday. Gives me a perfect level of hydration and leaves my skin soft and smooth as well as glowy, honestly one of my new favorite skin products! Hydration, a beautiful glow, and barrier support in one product that works and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, YES! It is a bit pricier but I think it's reasonable for the benefits and the bottle will last a while as only need a couple drops. This is one I will definitely be continuing to use!

Pros: lightweight formula, almost watery. Not sticky on the skin and absorbs quickly. Glass bottle is a nice touch and the applicator works fine. Cons: So. Much. Fragrance. It was just too much for me in a fave serum.
